For other versions, use one of these documentation indexes: - v2 (default): https://developer.ideogram.ai/v2/llms.txt - v1: https://developer.ideogram.ai/v1/llms.txt Edit Images Remix with Ideogram 4.0 (legacy) Copy page POST https://api.ideogram.ai / v1 / ideogram-v4 / remix POST / v1 / ideogram-v4 / remix cURL curl -X POST https://api.ideogram.ai/v1/ideogram-v4/remix \ -H Api-Key: apiKey \ -H Content-Type: multipart/form-data \ -F image=@string \ -F text_prompt= A photo of a cat Try it 200 Successful { created : 2024-01-15T09:30:00Z , data : [ { prompt : prompt , resolution : 1024x1024 , is_image_safe : true , seed : 12345 , url : https://ideogram.ai/api/images/ephemeral/xtdZiqPwRxqY1Y7NExFmzB.png?exp=1743867804 sig=e13e12677633f646d8531a153d20e2d3698dca9ee7661ee5ba4f3b64e7ec3f89 } , { prompt : prompt , resolution : 1024x1024 , is_image_safe : true , seed : 12345 , url : https://ideogram.ai/api/images/ephemeral/xtdZiqPwRxqY1Y7NExFmzB.png?exp=1743867804 sig=e13e12677633f646d8531a153d20e2d3698dca9ee7661ee5ba4f3b64e7ec3f89 } ] , response_type : url } Legacy: use POST /v2/image/remix/ideogram-4 instead. Remix an image synchronously using the Ideogram 4.0 model with an initial image and a prompt. Mirrors /v1/ideogram-v3/remix semantics (including image_weight for how strongly the output should resemble the input image) but routes the request through the V_4_0 model. Images links are available for a limited period of time; if you would like to keep the image, you must download it. Authentication Api-Key string API key for access control. Use in the header with the name “Api-Key” Request A request to remix an image with Ideogram 4.0. image file Required The initial image binary (max 25MB); only JPEG, WebP and PNG formats are supported. text_prompt string Required The text prompt that guides the remix. image_weight integer Optional 1-100 Optional. How strongly the output should resemble the input image. Higher values keep the input image’s structure; lower values allow the prompt to drive the output more. When omitted, the weight is chosen automatically from the edit instruction; supplying a value overrides that automatic choice. Only accepted when the output keeps the input image’s shape: combining image_weight with a resolution whose aspect ratio differs from the input image’s is rejected with a 400. resolution enum Optional Optional. When supplied, the images are generated at this resolution. When omitted, the input image’s shape is kept. A resolution whose aspect ratio differs from the input image’s cannot be combined with image_weight. Show 38 enum values rendering_speed enum Optional Defaults to DEFAULT The rendering speed to use. Allowed values : FLASH TURBO DEFAULT QUALITY enable_copyright_detection boolean or null Optional Optional. Opt this request into post-generation copyright detection (Hive likeness + logo checks). See GenerateImageRequestV3 for details. Response Image(s) generated successfully. created datetime The time the request was created. data list of objects A list of ImageObjects that contain the generated image(s). Show 5 properties response_type enum Optional Discriminator for the postGenerateDesignV4 oneOf response. Always url for this shape. Allowed values : url Errors 400 Bad Request Error 401 Unauthorized Error 422 Unprocessable Entity Error 429 Too Many Requests Error Was this page helpful?
